say:0:1820405001:1.text: You pick up the surgical clamp for a closer look. It's brand new, without a scratch on it. After brushing off the dust and dirt, it gleams with a cold metallic sheen.
say:0:1820405001:1.source_cn: 你捡起手术钳仔细端详。钳子是全新的，其上没有任何磨损痕...
say:0:1820405001:1.male: You pick up the surgical clamp for a closer look. It's brand new, without a scratch on it. After brushing off the dust and dirt, it gleams with a cold metallic sheen.
say:0:1820405001:1.female: You pick up the surgical clamp for a closer look. It's brand new, without a scratch on it. After brushing off the dust and dirt, it gleams with a cold metallic sheen.

say:1:1820405002:1.text: There's no doubt. This oddly shaped, somewhat menacing clamp is exactly the kind the Repair House uses.
say:1:1820405002:1.source_cn: 毫无疑问，面前这把造型古怪、略显狰狞的钳子正是修缮屋常...

say:2:1820405003:1.text: So this was the "surgical equipment" from Baba Muriel's shipment. What exactly happened to scatter these tools all over the ground?
say:2:1820405003:1.source_cn: 看来，这就是穆婆婆口中货物中的“手术器具”。运货车到底...
